verses: Haa Meem
Ain Seen Qaaf
Allah Taalaa jo zabardast hai aur hikmat wala hai ussi tarah teri taraf aur tujh say aglon ki taraf wahee bhejta raha
Aasmano ki (tamam) cheezen aur jo kuch zamin mein hai sab ussi ka hai woh bartar aur azeem azeem-ul-shaan hai

Qareeb hai aasman upper say phat paren aur tamam farishtay apney rab ki paki tareef kay sath biyan ker rahey hain aur zamin walon kay liye istaghfaar ker rahey hain. Khoob samajh rakho kay Allah Taalaa hi moaf farmaney wala rehmat wala hai
Aur jin logon ney uss kay siwa doosron ko kaarsaaz bana hai Allah Taalaa unn per nigaraan hai aur aap unn kay zimmay daar nahi hain

Ussi tarah hum ney aap ki taraf arabi Quran ki wahee ki hai takay aap Makkah walon ko aur uss kay aas pass kay logon ko khabardaar ker den aur jama honey kay din say jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi dara den. Aik giroh jannat mein hoga aur aik giroh jahannum mein hoga
Agar Allah Taalaa chahata to unn sab ko aik hi ummat ka bana deta lekin woh jissay chahata hai apni rehmat mein dakhil ker leta hai aur zalimon ka haami aur madadgar koi nahi
Kiya unn logon ney Allah Taalaa kay siwa aur kaarsaaz bana hain, (haqeeqatan to) Allah Taalaa hi kaarsaaz hai o hi mardon ko zindah keray ga aur o hi her cheez per qadir hai
Aur jiss jiss cheez mein tumhara ikhtilaf ho uss ka faisla Allah Taalaa hi ki taraf hai, yehi Allah mera rab hai jiss per mein ney bharosa ker rakha hai aur jiss ki taraf mein jhukta hun

Woh aasmano aur zamin ka peda kerney wala hai uss ney tumharay liye tumhari jinss kay joray bana hain aur chopayon kay joray banaye hain tumhen woh uss mein phela raha hai uss jaisi koi cheez nahi woh sunnay aur dekhney wala hai
Aasmano aur zamin ki kunjiyan ussi ki hain, jiss ki chahaye rozi kushadah kerdey aur tang kerdey, yaqeenan woh her cheez ko jannay wala hai

Allah Taalaa ney tumharay liye o hi deen muqarrar kerdiya hai jiss kay qaeem kerney ka uss ney Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ko hukum diya tha aur jo (ba-zariya wahee) hum ney teri taraf bhej di hai, aur jiss ka takeedi hukum hum ney Ibrahim aur Musa aur Isa (alaihim as-salam) ko diya tha, kay uss deen ko qaeem rakhna aur uss mein phoot na daalna jiss cheez ki taraf aap unhen bula rahey hain woh to (unn) mushrikeen per giran guzarti hai, Allah Taalaa jissay chahata hai apna bargazeedah banata hai aur jo bhi uss ki taraf rujoo keray woh uss ki sahih reh numaee kerta hai

Unn logon ney apney pass ilm aajaney kay baad hi ikhtilaf kiya (aur woh bhi) bahumi zidd behas say aur agar aap kay rab ki baat aik waqt muqarrar tak kay liye pehlay hi say qarar paa gaee hui na hoti to yaqeenan unn ka faisla chuka hota aur jin logon ko unn kay baad kitab di gaee hai woh bhi uss ki taraf say uljhan walay shak mein paray huye hain

Pus aap logon ko ussi taraf bulatay rahen aur jo kuch aap say kaha gaya hai uss per mazbooti say jamm jayen aur unn ki khuwaishon per na chalen aur keh den kay Allah Taalaa ney jitni kitaben nazil farmaee hain mera unn per eman hai aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay tum mein insaf kerta rahon. Humara aur tum sab ka perwerdigar Allah hi hai humaray aemaal humaray liye hain aur tumharay aemaal tumharay liye hain, hum tum mein koi kat hujjati nahi Allah Taalaa hum (sab) ko jama keray ga aur ussi ki taraf lotna hai

Aur jo log Allah Taalaa ki baaton mein jhagra daaltay hain uss kay baad kay (makhlooq) ussay maan chuki unn ki kat hujjati Allah kay nazdeek baatil hai, aur unn per ghazab hai aur unn kay liye sakht azab hai
Allah Taalaa ney haq kay sath kitab nazil farmaee hai aur tarazoo bhi (utari hai) aur aap ko kiya khabar shayad qayamat qareeb hi ho

Uss ki jaldi unhen pari hai jo ussay nahi mantay aur jo uss per yaqeen rakhtay hain woh to uss say darr rahey hain unhen uss kay haq honey ka poora ilm hai. Yaad rakho jo log qayamat kay moamla mein larr jhagar rahey hain, woh door ki gumrahi mein paray huye hain
Allah Taalaa apney bandon per bara hi lutf kerney wala hai, jissay chahata hai kushadah rozi deta hai aur woh bari taqat, baray ghalba wala hai

Jiss ka iradah aakhirat ki kheti ka ho hum ussay uss ki kheti mein taraqqi den gay aur jo duniya ki kheti ki talab rakhta ho hum ussay uss mein say hi kuch dey den gay, aisay shakhs ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi

Kiya unn logon ney aisay (Allah kay) shareek (muqarrar ker rakhay) hain jinhon ney aisay ehkaam deen muqarrar ker diye hain jo Allah kay farmaye huye nahi hain. Agar faislay kay din ka wada na hota to (abhi hi) unn mein faisla kerdiya jata. Yaqeenan (unn) zalimon kay liye hi dard-naak azab hai

Aap dekhen gay kay yeh zalim apney aemaal say darr rahey hun gay jin kay wabaal unn per waqey honey walay hain, aur jo log eman laye aur unhon ney nek aemaal kiye woh bahishton kay baghaat mein hun gay woh jo khuwahish keren apney rab kay pass mojood payen gay yehi hai bara fazal

Yehi woh hai jiss ki bisharat Allah Taalaa apney unn bandon ko dey raha hai jo eman laye aur (sunnat kay mutabiq) nek amal kiye to keh dijiye! kay mein uss per tum say koi badla nahi chahata magar mohabbat rishtay daari ki, jo shakhs koi neki keray hum uss kay liye uss ki neki mein aur neki barha den gay. Be-shak Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala (aur) boht qadar daan hai

Kiya yeh kehtay hain kay (payghumbar ney) Allah per jhoot bandha hai, agar Allah Taalaa chahaye to aap kay dil per mehar laga aur Allah Taalaa apni baaton say jhoot ko mita deta hai aur sach ko sabit rakhta hai. Woh seenay ki baaton ko jannay wala hai
O hi hai jo apney bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai aur gunahon say darguzar farmata hai aur jo kuch tum rahey ho (sab) janta hai
Eman walon aur nekokaar logon ki sunta hai aur unhen apney fazal say aur barha ker deta hai aur kuffaar kay liye sakht azab hai

Agar Allah Taalaa apney (sab) bandon ki rozi farakh ker deta to woh zamin mein fasad barpa ker detay lekin woh andazay kay sath jo kuch chahata hai nazil farmata hai. Woh apney bandon say poora khabardaar hai aur khoob dekhney wala hai
Aur o hi hai jo logon kay na-umeed hojaney kay baad barish barsata aur apni rehmat phela deta hai o hi hai kaarsaaz aur qabil hamd o sana
Aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say aasmano aur zamin ki pedaeesh hai aur unn mein jaandaron ka phelana hai. Woh uss per bhi qadir hai kay jab chahaye unhen jama kerdey
Tumhen jo kuch musibaten phonchti hain woh tumharay apney hathon kay kartoot badla hai, aur woh to boht si baaton say darguzar farma deta hai
Aur tum humen zamin mein aajiz kerney walay nahi ho, tumharay liye siwaye Allah Taalaa kay na koi kaarsaaz hai na madadgar
Aur darya mein chalney wali paharon jaisi kashtiyan uss ki nishaniyon mein say hain
Agar woh chahaye to hua band kerdey aur yeh kashtiyan samandaron per ruki reh jayen. Yaqeenan uss mein her sabar kerney walay shukar-guzar kay liye nishaniyan hain
Ya unhen unn kay kartooton kay baees tabah kerdey, woh to boht say khataon say darguzar farmaya kerta hai
Aur takay jo log humari nishaniyon mein jhagartay hain woh maloom kerlen kay unn kay liye koi chutkara nahi

To tumhen jo kuch diya gaya hai woh zindagani duniya ka kuch yunhi sa asbaab hai, aur Allah kay pass jo hai woh uss say ba-darja behtar aur payedaar hai, woh unn kay liye hai jo eman laye aur sirf apney rab hi per bharosa rakhtay hain
Aur kabeerah gunahon say aur bey hayaeeyon say bachtay hain aur ghussay kay waqt (bhi) moaf ker detay hain

Aur apney rab kay farman ko qabool kertay hain aur namaz ki pabandi kertay hain aur unn ka (her) kaam aapas kay mashwaray say hota hai, aur jo hum ney unhen dey rakha hai uss mein say (humaray naam per) detay hain
Aur jab unn per zulm (o ziyadti) ho to woh sirf badla ley letay hain
Aur buraee ka badla ussi jaisi buraee hai, aur jo moaf ker dey aur islaah kerley uss ka ajar Allah kay zimmay hai, (fi fil-waqey) Allah Taalaa zalimon say mohabbat nahi kerta
Aur jo shakhs apney mazloom honey kay baad (barabar ka) badla ley ley to aisay logon per (ilzam ka) koi raasta nahi
Yeh raasta sirf unn logon per hai jo khud doosron per zulm keren aur zamin mein na-haq fasad kertay phiren, yehi log hain jin kay liye dard-naak azab hai
Aur jo shakhs sabar ker ley aur moaf kerdey yaqeenan yeh bari himmat kay kaamon mein say (aik kaam) hai
Aur jissay Allah Taalaa behka dey uss ka uss kay baad koi chara saaz nahi, aur to dekhay ga kay zalim log azab ko dekh ker keh rahey hun gay kay kiya wapis janey ki koi raah hai

Aur to unhen dekhay ga kay woh (jahannum kay) samney la-kharay kiye jayen gay maaray zillat kay jhukay jarahey hun gay aur kan-ankhiyon say dekh rahey hun gay, eman walay saaf kahen gay kay haqeeqi ziyan kaar woh hain jinhon ney aaj qayamat kay din apney aap ko aur apney ghar walon ko nuksan mein daal diya. Yaad rakho kay yaqeenan zalim log daeemi azab mein hain
Unn kay koi madadgar nahi jo Allah Taalaa say alag unn ki imdad saken aur jissay Allah gumrah kerdey uss kay liye koi raasta hi nahi
Apney rab ka hukum maan lo uss say pehlay kay Allah ki janib say woh din aajaye jiss ka hatt jana na-mumkin hai, tumhen uss roz na to koi panah ki jagah milay gi na chup ker anjan bann janey ki

Agar yeh mun pher to hum ney aap ko unn per nigehbaan bana ker nahi bheja, aap kay zimmay to sirf paygham phoncha dena hai, hum jab kabhi insan ko apni meharbani ka maza chakhatay hain to woh uss per itra jata hai aur agar unhen unn kay aemaal ki wajah say koi museebat phonchti hai to be-shak insan bara hi nashukra hai
Aasmano ki aur zamin ki saltanat Allah Taalaa hi kay liye hai, woh jo chahata hai peda kerta hai jiss ko chahata hai betiyan deta hai aur jissay chahata hai betay deta hai
Ya unhen jama ker deta hai betay bhi aur betiyan bhi aur jissay chahaye baanjh ker deta hai, woh baray ilm wala aur kamil qudrat wala hai

Na-mumkin hai kay kissi bandah say Allah Taalaa kalaam keray magar wahee kay zariye ya parday kay peechay say ya kissi farishta ko bhejay aur woh Allah kay hukum say jo woh chahaye wahee keray, be-shak woh bartar hai hikmat wala hai

Aur ussi tarah hum ney aap ki taraf apney hukum say rooh ko utara hai, aap uss say pehlay yeh bhi nahi jantay thay kay kitab aur eman kiya cheez hai? Lekin hum ney ussay noor banaya, uss kay zariye say apney bandon mein say jissay chahatay hain, hidayat detay hain, be-shak aap raah raast ki rehnumaee ker rahey hain
Uss Allah ki raah ki jiss ki milkiyat mein aasmano aur zamin ki her cheez hai. Aagah raho sab kaam Allah Taalaa hi ki taraf lottay hain
